QR & Barcode Scanner Pro: AI Translate & Google Sheets

Looking for a scanner app that does much more than just reading codes? QR & Barcode Scanner Pro is your ultimate all-in-one solution for business inventory, smart data logging, and daily productivity. Packed with cutting-edge AI Live Translate (OCR), seamless Google Sheets integration, and an instant Scan to PDF feature, this app turns your smartphone camera into a powerful, lightning-fast scanning tool.

🚀 Why Choose Our QR & Barcode Scanner?

📊 1. Real-Time Export to Google Sheets & Excel
Streamline your stock counting and inventory management without manual typing! Simply scan any product barcode, and the data instantly populates your Google Sheets or Excel spreadsheets in real-time. This bulk-scan and logging capability is perfect for small business owners, warehouse managers, e-commerce sellers, and logistics teams.

🤖 2. AI Live Camera Translate (Instant OCR)
Struggling with foreign text on documents, packages, signboards, or restaurant menus? Just point your camera! Powered by advanced AI OCR technology, the app detects text and provides instant, real-time translations directly on your screen. No need to copy and paste text manually anymore.

📄 3. Smart Document Scanner & Scan to PDF
Convert your scanned barcodes, QR codes, or visual text into high-quality PDF documents. You can easily organize your scanning history, group items into categories, and share them via WhatsApp, Email, or Cloud Storage with just a single tap.

⚡ 4. Lightning-Fast Scan & All Format Support

Barcode Scanner Phone app + Calibre

I've used this (Android) barcode scanner before: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sukronmoh.bwi.barcodescanner

On Calibre, simply go to "Add Books" > "Add books by ISBN", and paste a list of ISBNS. It will automatically download metadata and images for them.
